'''Coro Lanra''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who had worked at the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] for over fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] on projects such as the [[CZ-X32 Sublimation Matrix]]. While working at the [[CZ-198]] research facility, Lanra left the lab without a security badge, and the security guard refused to let the scientist back in, acting as though he didn't recognize Lanra. The guard then called the director on the intercom to verify Lanra's security clearance, and after the incident several security guards found it amusing to ask the scientist for a security badge whenever Lanra got a cup of [[Caf/Legends|caf]]&mdash;something that led Lanra to file a format complaint about the incident.<ref name="Formal Complaint" />
